plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked calculation table and curve from Svante Arrhenius's April 1896 paper shows global temperature change vs atmospheric CO₂ multiplier: 0.67× CO₂ → −3.2 °C; 0.5× CO₂ (halved) → −4 to −5 °C (Ice Age); 1.0× CO₂ → baseline; and 2.0× CO₂ (doubled) → +5 to +6 °C, compared alongside Syukuro Manabe and Richard Wetherald's May 1967 computer model (+2.3 to +3.0 °C).

teach_overlay.scale: working only with pencil and paper in 1895, Arrhenius calculated a warming curve for doubled carbon dioxide within two degrees of today's fastest supercomputers
